ADAPTIVE_PROPOSALS.reason: per-row proposal width vs the fixed rows; off by default

ANE_WAIT.reason: milliseconds a decode step waits on the ANE predraft before running the GPU draft; inert unless an ANE predraft artifact is loaded

DFLASH_POOL.reason: the 128-slot pool selector over the merged top-16; off by default

DRAFT_BYPASS.reason: anchor-only decode when the draft's acceptance EWMA is low

DRAFT_BYPASS_EXPECT.reason: the acceptance EWMA below which the batch bypasses the draft

DRAFT_CONF_MIN.reason: DSpark confidence-head suffix prune: verify rows end at the first proposal whose head sigmoid falls under the floor; 0 off

DRAFT_SPLITS.reason: draft attention tile splits vs the compiled 4; off-table values ride the draft kernel's function constant

GDN_CHUNKED.reason: the WY/UT chunked prefill scan vs the serial one; off by default

GGUF_PACKED.reason: packed GGUF decode operands; off by default

HEAD_FUSED.reason: the fused greedy argmax head vs the logits-then-sample path

ICB_OFF.reason: direct dispatch vs the baked indirect command buffer; ICB on by default

MOE_PACKED_OFF.reason: the unpacked expert path vs the packed one; packed on by default

MOE_UNION.reason: routed-expert union cap per decode step; off by default — drops each row's routes that miss the union without renormalizing, so every cap changes the emitted tokens (measured: cap 16 diverges from the baseline stream at token 8)

MTL4.reason: the Metal 3 command-graph path vs the default Metal 4 one; MTL4 on by default

NGRAM_DRAFT_EXPECT.reason: expected acceptance a lane must total to go predrafted

NGRAM_PREDRAFT.reason: the learning-free n-gram predraft; on by default

NGRAM_TREE_MIN.reason: EWMA a lane needs before its table emits sibling leaves

NGRAM_WARMUP.reason: rounds before a lane's acceptance EWMA is trusted

NO_FUSED_GATE.reason: the two-pass verify reduce vs the fused out-projection fold; on by default

PATCHABLE_OFF.reason: non-bakeable spans vs the patchable-payload replay; on by default

PREFILL_FAST_INT8.reason: the split int8 prefill operand path; off by default

PREPARED_CACHE_OFF.reason: full command prepare vs the prepared-command cache; cache on by default

PROPOSAL_CAP.reason: per-step proposal cap vs the draft's trained block limit

SCORE_GATHER.reason: all-score batches dispatch only the quant tiles of the head holding a wanted logit column; off by default

SCORE_TENSOR.reason: all-score batches gather the wanted logit columns in one gguf_decode_score dispatch instead of per-tile-run dispatches; off by default

SCORE_FUSED.reason: the score gather's single dispatch also runs the final RMS norm in-kernel, removing the norm dispatch and its buffer round trip; off by default

SCORE_TENSOR_PREFILL.reason: prefill chunks of decode-tile size take the packed-operand tensor kernels where the format has one; off by default

SUBMIT_AHEAD.reason: a second prefill command overlapping the running one; off by default

SYSTEMONE_WINDOW.reason: in-flight questions the systemone preparation runs below its bound; the runtime never reads it

VERIFY_TREE.reason: comb-tree verify of draft proposals; off-by-default on GPU drafts

DECODE_RING2.reason: single pending decode command vs the depth-2 submit-ahead ring; ring on by default

DEVICE_VERIFY_PARAMS.reason: host-staged verify params vs the step-pack device buffer; device params on by default

CONV_FUSE.reason: separate conv output-projection prepare vs the mixer's fused Table16 emission; fused on by default

GPU_PREDRAFT.reason: the device-side packing of next-step draft inputs; on by default

VERIFY_ALL_LIVE.reason: every verify row treated live vs the anchor-fill routing; anchor-fill on by default

VERIFY_SPLITS_MAX.reason: verify attention split ceiling vs the compiled 128; lower caps only

VERIFY_SPLIT_R2.reason: the kv4/g6 16-row chain verify's two fused-row passes across two threadgroups (_r2) vs one group; _r2 on by default (1.40x at 4K history, 1.24x at 131K)

PREFILL_SPLITS_MAX.reason: prefill attention split ceiling vs the compiled 32; lower caps only

TREE_ACCEPT_MIN.reason: the acceptance EWMA below which the batch stops treeing vs the default 0

TREE_ACCEPT_MAX.reason: the acceptance EWMA above which the batch stops treeing vs the default 6

MOE_GGUF_FUSED.reason: the fused gate+up GGUF expert kernel vs the split pair; off by default

MOE_GGUF_TILE.reason: forced GGUF expert tile vs the device policy's pick

DFA_MODE.reason: host mask round trip with device forced spans, or every constraint on the host path; the unset default is full

DFA_MERGE_OFF.reason: the three-command split vs the merged draft+verify+commit command for full-DFA batches; merged on by default

DFA_SPAN_SKIP_DRAFT_OFF.reason: draft and forward encodes under a fully-covered forced span vs skipping them; skipping on by default

GPU_DECODE_GRID_OFF.reason: host-written verify mask grid vs the device-written indirect grid; device grid on by default
